text.en: Long-time boarding and cat grooming clients praise the team on North 7th Avenue for patient care with anxious dogs and fussy cats. However, three reviewers reported serious welfare concerns, including an unattended grooming fatality, post-grooming skin sores, and stressful cat kennels near barking dogs.

Several pet owners describe the staff as welcoming, patient, and accommodating when handling special care requests or waiving fees after a cancelled stay. Conversely, two critical grooming reviews raised serious concerns regarding groomer supervision and accountability during appointments.

Regular clients who bring cats and small dogs for trims report tidy haircuts and reliable routine grooming over several years. In contrast, two dog owners reported severe negative outcomes following grooming appointments, including painful skin sores that required veterinary treatment.

q.en: Does Alta Vista Boarding & Grooming offer cat grooming?

a.en: Yes, the salon provides feline grooming services starting at $90, and cat owners mention bringing their pets for regular grooming appointments.

q.en: Can dogs of all sizes be groomed and boarded here?

a.en: Yes, the facility accommodates dogs of all sizes for both full grooming packages and overnight or daytime boarding.

q.en: What should cat owners know before boarding?

a.en: One reviewer advised inspecting the feline boarding area beforehand, noting it was close to the dog kennels and noisy.
